items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: the fellow that got drowned, Dejon his name was.

ctx.x: Was that up at the, at the river?

Yeah, you see well they had, they had a little ferry boat you know what I mean. But it was no large ferry boat like Conair Street ferry. Yeah. But it was, it run certain time and, and, and, and, and it don't run no more. Yeah. You know certain time in the evening late you see. Yeah. Well that was, that would be for the people coming from the courthouse on the other side you see. And people from going from white you know what I mean like that too you know coming to the, to the, to the sugary farm you see. So well,…
